scope: SDevice-only edge localization of M17 quasi-Fermi imbalance and equation-feedback ledger

default_model_policy.modify_cpp: diagnostic-only edge output for the M17 secant-factor probe

edge_response.factor_game: reuse the exact M17 mobility, SG secant conductance, and QF log-imbalance eight-vertex game
edge_response.edge_shapley: calculate the three-factor Shapley value independently on each finite-volume edge
edge_response.adjoint_weight: lambda_electron(node1)-lambda_electron(node0), with constrained electron-continuity rows assigned zero lambda
edge_response.closure: sum of weighted edge factors must reproduce M17 node-factor totals

edge_partition.contact_cut_rule: an edge with exactly one endpoint in the named contact node set
edge_partition.internal_channel: no contact-cut classification and midpoint x_um<=0.25 and -0.3<=midpoint y_um<=0.3
edge_partition.internal_source: no contact-cut classification and midpoint x_um<=0.25 and midpoint y_um<-0.3
edge_partition.internal_drain: no contact-cut classification and midpoint x_um<=0.25 and midpoint y_um>0.3
edge_partition.internal_body: no contact-cut classification and midpoint x_um>0.25

feedback_ledger.electron_transport: replace the M15 electron_transport term with the three M17 stable factors
feedback_ledger.poisson: reuse M15 Poisson adjoint-weighted operator response
feedback_ledger.srh: sum M15 electron_srh and hole_srh responses
feedback_ledger.boundary_gauge: sum M15 electron/hole boundary and gauge responses
feedback_ledger.other_carrier: sum M15 hole transport and impact terms plus electron impact
feedback_ledger.closure: ledger must reproduce the complete M15 adjoint-weighted operator response

decision_questions: Do source or drain contact-cut edges carry a material share of the key-state QF-imbalance response?
Is the key-state QF response localized inside the channel rather than at terminal boundaries?
Are direct SRH residuals material in the self-consistent adjoint feedback ledger?
Which individual edges and lateral locations dominate the remaining QF response?
interpretation_limits: The adjoint edge response is first-order self-consistent sensitivity around the converged Vela state.
A negligible direct SRH operator term does not prove SRH had no historical influence on the converged state.
The edge partition localizes Vela operator response and is not a native Sentaurus residual decomposition.
Sub-fA relative responses remain conditioning-sensitive and are not headline root-cause evidence.
